commits.message: Review: a Prepend ends its cluster only before a base, the end slot keeps its own clusters, and a write ending on a Prepend ends it (rich-control-codes-xh4n.qmw)
A Prepend character is its own cluster, and sealed writes a word joiner after it so a clustering terminal agrees (rich-control-codes-xh4n.qmw)

Under logical, a step walks the stops the terminal shows on the whole painted line: the caret's end blank keeps a right-to-left row's level when a neighbour's text follows it (rich-control-codes-xh4n.bx4) (#570)

* Under logical, a step walks the stops the terminal shows on the whole painted line: the caret's end blank keeps a right-to-left row's level when a neighbour's text follows it (rich-control-codes-xh4n.bx4)

* A key and a press carry the frame they were heard on, and a step cuts the line at the row that frame drew (rich-control-codes-xh4n.bx4)

Review of #570: the focused-only framePainted push left a blurred field, a
render between paints and a cursor moved before a repaint reading a frame
other than the one on screen, behind a layout-identity guard. WidgetKeyEvent
and WidgetMouseEvent now hold the frame; the field keeps none.

* One Frame type for what an event carries, a press orders the line only when it lands past the row, and docs/widgets.md names an event's frame (rich-control-codes-xh4n.bx4)
